arxiv-1908-07324.title: A Microphone Array and Voice Algorithm based Smart Hearing Aid
arxiv-1908-07324.creator: 1 st Bharath Sudharsan, 2 nd Manigandan Chockalingam
arxiv-1908-07324.description: Abstract Approximately 6.2% of the world’s population (466 million people) suffer from disabling hearing impairment [ 1 ] . Hearing impairment impacts negatively on one’s education, financial success [ 2 ] [ 3 ] , cognitive development in childhood [ 4 ] , including increased risk of dementia in older adulthood [ 5 ] .

arxiv-2105-13394.title: A Multi-Wavelength Study of Star Formation in 15 Local Star-Forming Galaxies 2021 A Multi-Wavelength Study of Star Formation in 15 Local Star-Forming Galaxies – 48
arxiv-2105-13394.creator: Madison V. Smith, L. van Zee, S. Salim, D. Dale, S. Staudaher, T. Wrock, A. Maben
arxiv-2105-13394.description: Abstract We have fit the far-ultraviolet (FUV) to mid-infrared (MIR) spectral energy distributions (SEDs) for several nearby galaxies ( < < 20 Mpc). Global, radial, and local photometric measurements are explored to better understand how SED-derived star formation histories (SFHs) and classic star formation rate (SFR) tracers manifest at different scales.

arxiv-2107-04301.title: Duality-symmetric axion electrodynamics and haloscopes of various geometries
arxiv-2107-04301.creator: Dai-Nam Le, Le Phuong Hoang, Binh Xuan Cao
arxiv-2107-04301.description: Abstract Within the dual symmetric point of view, the theory for seeking axion dark matter via haloscope experiments is derived by exactly solving the dual symmetric axion electrodynamics equation. Notwithstanding that the conventional theory of axion electrodynamics presented in [ Phys. Rev. Lett. 51 , 1415 (1983) and J. Phys. A: Math. Gen.

arxiv-2111-06427.title: Uncovering astrometric black hole binaries with massive main-sequence companions with Gaia
arxiv-2111-06427.creator: Soetkin Janssens, S. Janssens, T. Shenar, H. Sana, S. Faigler, N. Langer, P. Marchant, T. Mazeh, C. Schürmann, S. Shahaf
arxiv-2111-06427.description: Abstract Context. In the era of gravitational wave astrophysics and precise astrometry of billions of stellar sources, the hunt for compact objects is more alive than ever. Rarely seen massive binaries with a compact object are a crucial phase in the evolution towards compact object mergers.

arxiv-2304-03051.title: Matrix models for the nested hypergeometric tau-functions
arxiv-2304-03051.creator: Alexander Alexandrov
arxiv-2304-03051.description: Abstract . We introduce and investigate a family of tau-functions of the 2D Toda hierarchy, which is a natural generalization of the hypergeometric family associated with Hurwitz numbers. For this family we prove a skew Schur function expansion formula. For arbitrary rational weight generating functions we construct the multi-matrix models. Two different types of cut-and-join descriptions are derived.

arxiv-2307-04417.title: Fairness-aware Federated Minimax Optimization with Convergence Guarantee Thanks: This work was supported by a grant from the NSFC/RGC Joint Research Scheme sponsored by the Research Grants Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China and National Natural Science Foundation of China
arxiv-2307-04417.creator: Gerry Windiarto Mohamad Dunda, Shenghui Song
arxiv-2307-04417.description: Abstract Federated learning (FL) has garnered considerable attention due to its privacy-preserving feature. Nonetheless, the lack of freedom in managing user data can lead to group fairness issues, where models are biased towards sensitive factors such as race or gender.

arxiv-2309-03717.title: Parallel processing of radio signals and detector arrays in CORSIKA 8
arxiv-2309-03717.creator: Tim Huege
arxiv-2309-03717.description: Abstract This contribution describes some recent advances in the parallelization of the generation and processing of radio signals emitted by particle showers in CORSIKA 8. CORSIKA 8 is a Monte Carlo simulation framework for modeling ultra-high energy particle cascades in astroparticle physics.

arxiv-2403-05211.title: Improving the Successful Robotic Grasp Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks
arxiv-2403-05211.creator: 1 st Hamed Hosseini, 2 nd Mehdi Tale Masouleh, 3 rd Ahmad Kalhor
arxiv-2403-05211.description: Abstract Robotic grasp should be carried out in a real-time manner by proper accuracy. Perception is the first and significant step in this procedure. This paper proposes an improved pip line model trying to detect grasp as a rectangle representation for different seen or unseen objects.

arxiv-2404-19631.title: On Training a Neural Network to Explain Binaries
arxiv-2404-19631.creator: Alex Interrante-Grant, Andy Davis, Heather Preslier, Tim Leek
arxiv-2404-19631.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alex Interrante-Grant, Andy Davis, Heather Preslier, Tim Leek. In this work, we begin to investigate the possibility of training a deep neural network on the task of binary code understanding. Specifically, the network would take, as input, features derived directly from binaries and output English descriptions of functionality to aid a reverse engineer in investigating the capabilities of a piece of closed-source software, be it malicious or benign.

arxiv-2410-22836.title: Mesoscopic modelling of bio-compatible PLGA polymers with coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations
arxiv-2410-22836.creator: Francesco Maria Bellussi, Matteo Ricci, Matteo Fasano, Otello Maria Roscioni
arxiv-2410-22836.description: Abstract A challenging topic in materials engineering is the development of numerical models that can accurately predict material properties with atomistic accuracy, matching the scale and level of detail achieved by experiments. In this regard, coarse-grained (CG) molecular dynamics (MD) simulations are a popular method for achieving this goal.

arxiv-2502-17623.title: SET-PAiREd : Designing for Parental Involvement in Learning with an AI-Assisted Educational Robot
arxiv-2502-17623.creator: Hui-Ru Ho, Nitigya Kargeti, Ziqi Liu, Bilge Mutlu
arxiv-2502-17623.description: Abstract . AI-assisted learning companion robots are increasingly used in early education. Many parents express concerns about content appropriateness, while they also value how AI and robots could supplement their limited skill, time, and energy to support their children’s learning. We designed a card-based kit, SET , to systematically capture scenarios that have different extents of parental involvement.

britannica-1911-champlain-samuel-de.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-champlain-samuel-de.description: Article 'Champlain, Samuel de' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 5), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. colonial pioneer and first governor of French Canada, was born at Brouage, a small French port on the Bay of Biscay, in 1567. His father was a sea captain, and the boy was early skilled in seamanship and navigation. He entered the army of Henry IV., and served in Brittany under Jean d’Aumont, François de St Luc and Charles de Brissac.

pmc-10606790.title: A broad-spectrum pneumococcal vaccine induces mucosal immunity and protects against lethal Streptococcus pneumoniae challenge
pmc-10606790.creator: Fang-Feng Chiu, Ling-Ling Tu, Wangxue Chen, Hongyan Zhou, Bing-Sin Liu, Shih-Jen Liu, Chih-Hsiang Leng
pmc-10606790.description: Pneumococcal disease is a major threat to public health globally, impacting individuals across all age groups, particularly infants and elderly individuals. The use of current vaccines has led to unintended consequences, including serotype replacement, leading to a need for a new approach to combat pneumococcal disease. A promising solution is the development of a broad-spectrum pneumococcal vaccine.

pmc-10656801.title: Cutaneous mantle cell lymphoma presenting as a diffuse morbilliform rash: A case report
pmc-10656801.creator: Spencer Tuohy, Christopher Wachuku, Yixin A Wang, Aman Prasad, Sara S Samimi, Lisa K Pappas-Taffer, Paul L Haun, Leo L Wang
pmc-10656801.description: This case describes a patient with known mantle cell lymphoma without cutaneous involvement presenting with a diffuse morbilliform rash during an inpatient admission for bacterial pneumonia. The patient was thought to have a hypersensitivity to antibiotics but failed to improve after the offending agents were stopped. A skin biopsy revealed metastatic cutaneous mantle cell lymphoma.

pmc-11481352.title: Activity-based contracting for optimization of the mass distribution of insecticide-treated nets in the Democratic Republic of Congo: pilot implementation in Kwilu province
pmc-11481352.creator: Losimba Likwela J, Kalonji Ntumba A, Ndolerire Isingoma C, Mukomena Sompwe E, Tsasa Mbuku E, Mbuse Angembo F, Mbuyu Lukunde E, Lukanu Ngwala P., N.’siala Kumbi A, Panou I, Masoswa L, Mashako P, Kanku‑Ka‑Lukusa P, Kulimushi Ndahambara G, Luntadila Kiamenga M, Minuku Kinzonzi F, Ngoma Kintaudi L, Wier
pmc-11481352.description: BackgroundPromoting the use of insecticide-treated mosquito nets (ITNs) is one of the main strategies for reducing malaria-related morbidity. An innovative activity-based contracting (ABC) approach has been implemented in Kwilu Province, Democratic Republic of Congo to optimize ITN mass distribution campaigns, with payments based on contractually defined programmatic outcomes for key campaign activities following independent verification of results.

pmc-12377157.title: Beyond reflection: using the clinician educator milestones in faculty development
pmc-12377157.creator: Era Buck, Flavio M Monteiro, Kimberly Turner
pmc-12377157.description: Introduction. Faculty in academic medicine face increasing clinical and research demands, often limiting time for professional development and identity formation as educators. The ACGME Clinician Educator Milestones offer a structured framework for reflection and self-assessment, but their usefulness for broader applications such as needs assessment and program evaluation remains unexplored.

pmc-13153358.title: Auxiliary subunits reshape structural asymmetry and functional plasticity in heterotetrameric GluA1/A2 AMPA receptor core
pmc-13153358.creator: Laura Y Yen, Thomas P Newton, Maria V Yelshanskaya, Muhammed Aktolun, Shanti Pal Gangwar, Rasmus P Clausen, Maria G Kurnikova, Alexander I Sobolevsky
pmc-13153358.description: AMPA-subtype ionotropic glutamate receptors (AMPARs) mediate the fast component of excitatory neurotransmission. They govern synaptic plasticity that underlies learning and memory, while their dysregulation is implicated in numerous neurological disorders. The functional diversity of AMPARs arises from variations in their subunit composition and also their association with auxiliary subunits.

pmc-13342897.title: Beyond genital phenotype – Commentary on "Long-term outcomes in 45,X/46,XY mosaicism: a 30-year retrospective study in Hong Kong"
pmc-13342897.creator: So Yoon Jung
pmc-13342897.description: es. This variability complicates decisions about sex assignment, gonadal management, growth, and long-term follow-up. Poon et al. [1] reported long-term outcomes in a large cohort of individuals with 45,X/46,XY mosaicism followed into adulthood, adding valuable data on gonadal tumors, pubertal development, growth, and Turner syndrome-associated comorbidities. A key finding is the association between external genital phenotype and gonadal tumor risk.

pmc-13356610.title: Perceptions of essential oral health care and locus of control among adults in a developing country
pmc-13356610.creator: Aparna K.S., Ritu Duggal, Vijay P. Mathur, Harsh Priya, Bharathi M. Purohit, Sarah Paul, Neha Chauhan
pmc-13356610.description: BackgroundOral diseases are among the most prevalent global health problems, disproportionately affecting disadvantaged populations. Essential Oral Health Care (EOHC), endorsed by the World Health Organization, comprises basic promotive, preventive, and curative services that should be universally accessible. Public perceptions and psychological factors, particularly Locus of Control (LOC), strongly influence oral health behaviors and service use.

pmc-13382398.title: Comprehensive characterization of myopic guinea pigs' retina following PI3K/AKT inhibition using a data-independent acquisition dataset on an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer
pmc-13382398.creator: Hu Xiao, Wen Xin, Oi Ying Wong, Man Hin Leung, Jimmy Ka-Wai Cheung, Da Qian Lu, Lei Zhou, Rachel Ka Man Chun, Jing Fang Bian, Thomas Chuen Lam
pmc-13382398.description: Myopia has emerged as a global ocular health concern. The progression of myopia is predominantly driven by abnormal signaling pathways, with the PI3K/AKT pathway playing a crucial role. By utilizing the lens-induced myopia model in guinea pigs, we intravitreally injected the PI3K/AKT inhibitor LY294002 and carried out quantitative proteomic analysis using data-independent acquisition mass spectrometry.

pmc-13442805.title: Integrated immunophenotypic and ProMisE molecular profiling as predictors of immune checkpoint inhibitor response in recurrent endometrial cancer
pmc-13442805.creator: Komei Katayama, Nobuhisa Yoshikawa, Wenting Liu, Kae Nakamura, Satomi Hattori, Mei Kubokawa, Shohei Iyoshi, Kosuke Yoshida, Masato Yoshihara, Yukari Nagao, Satoshi Tamauchi, Akira Yokoi, Kaoru Niimi, Yusuke Shimizu, Yosuke Kawai, Fumi Utsumi, Eri Watanabe, Shiro Suzuki, Kiyosumi Shibata, Hiroaki Kaj
pmc-13442805.description: BackgroundImmune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) are an important treatment option for recurrent endometrial cancer (EC); however, responses vary widely. Although the ProMisE molecular classification provides prognostic and predictive insights, it does not fully explain the heterogeneity of ICI outcomes. Further characterization of the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) is required to refine biomarker development.
